landing.heroHeading: Private AI-powered astrology insights, in your language.
landing.heroSub: Explore personalized astrology-style guidance for career, relationships, marriage, business, and daily reflection — in Gujarati, Hindi, or English.
landing.step1Desc: Add your birth date, time, and place — or skip and just ask a question. Everything is optional and private.
landing.step2Desc: Ask about career, relationships, business, or daily life in your own language and get a calm, reflective response.
landing.step3Desc: Every answer is clearly labelled as AI-generated guidance — for reflection, not certainty.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need for astrology-style reflection
landing.featureChatDesc: A calm chat companion for career, marriage, business, and daily questions.
landing.featureHoroscopeDesc: Daily, weekly, and monthly outlooks for all 12 zodiac signs.
landing.featureKundliDesc: A structured view of your sun sign, moon sign, ascendant, and more.
landing.featureCompatibilityDesc: General relationship compatibility insight for two people.
landing.featureReportsDesc: Deeper, purchasable reports for career, marriage, and the year ahead.
landing.featureLanguageDesc: Full Gujarati and Hindi support alongside English, everywhere in the app.
landing.languageSectionTitle: Built for Gujarat, made for everyone
landing.languageSectionDesc: Prerna AI reads and replies naturally in Gujarati, Hindi, and English — switch anytime in settings.
landing.privacySectionDesc: Birth data is optional, encrypted in transit, never sold, and can be deleted permanently at any time.
landing.pricingSectionDesc: See exactly what you get before you pay. No hidden fees, no false discounts.
landing.sampleInsightBody: "This is a reflective period for reassessing your career direction. Consider what has felt meaningful this year, and take one small, concrete step toward it this week."
landing.sampleInsightNote: Sample AI-generated output shown for illustration — your own insight will reflect your details and question.
landing.publicAskPlaceholder: e.g. What should I focus on in my career this month?
landing.publicAskRateLimited: You've used your free questions for today. Sign up for more — including personalized, birth-chart-based guidance.
landing.publicAskErrorGeneric: Something went wrong — please try again.
landing.publicAskCta: Sign up for unlimited questions and answers personalized to your birth chart.
landing.testimonialsNote: Demo placeholders shown for illustration — not verified user reviews.
landing.finalCtaTitle: Ready for a moment of reflection?
landing.finalCtaSub: Your first 3 questions are free. No card required.
landing.footerTagline: Private AI-powered astrology insights in your language.

onboarding.step1Desc: You can change this anytime in settings.
onboarding.step2Desc: Prerna AI gives AI-generated astrology-style guidance for reflection — not certain predictions. For medical, legal, financial, or emergency decisions, please consult a qualified professional.
onboarding.step5Desc: Your birth date helps personalize your insights. This is optional.
onboarding.step6UnknownTime: I don't know my exact birth time
onboarding.step6Desc: An exact time gives more specific results, but it's not required.
onboarding.step7Hint: Pick from the list for the most accurate chart — including villages and small towns worldwide.
onboarding.step8Desc: Pick your main interest — you can explore everything either way.
onboarding.step9Desc: Birth details are sensitive. We only store them if you consent, you can edit or delete them anytime, and they're never sold.
onboarding.step9Consent: I consent to Prerna AI storing my birth details to personalize insights.
onboarding.step10Desc: Your dashboard is ready. Let's take a look.
